items.title: Pug Horton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 22, 1998
items.q: Bob has always said if Benny [Goodman] didn’t play this he should have done it.

ctx.x: Well that gives a whole different spin to the lyrics of “I’ll See You In My Dreams” to see it like that.

Yes it does. But I think that you can, if you think about all the great songs that there’s a way of hearing them and thinking. Bob has always said if Benny [Goodman] didn’t play this he should have done it.
What circumstances brought you to the United States?
